source.note: ClientHello, HTTP/2 frames and header sets are those captured for chrome-131-macos; wreq-util declares opera 123 to use the same TLS and HTTP/2 configuration (opera123: tls_options!('CURVES',), http2_options!(())). The User-Agent is wreq-util's; accept-language is wreq-util's. Nothing was seen on the wire for this version here. wreq-util gives every Opera version one tuple — the ALPS codepoint of Chromium 131 — although the User-Agent names Chromium up to 147; taken as claimed. sec-ch-ua recomputed on 2026-09-26: wreq-util's string was wrong for this version (copied from another version); computed from the Chromium major as the browser computes it.
